title: With channel 'chrome' or 'msedge', PDF downloads stop firing and screenshots change after Playwright 1.49
symptoms: page.waitForEvent('download') times out on a PDF link because the PDF opens inline
toHaveScreenshot diffs across the whole suite with no app change
Tests pass in default headless Chromium and fail with channel: 'chrome'
cause: Chrome and Edge removed old headless, so branded channels now run the new headless mode, which renders PDFs in the page and paints differently. Default Playwright Chromium uses a separate headless shell and is not affected.
fix: Assert on the opened PDF page or fetch the file with the request API instead of waiting for a download, and regenerate screenshot baselines per channel.
affected: Playwright 1.49 and later with channel chrome, chrome-beta, msedge and similar
